app.title: TextFromTrack Roon Companion
app.subtitle: Automated LRC lyrics for your Roon library
app.credits_refresh: Click to refresh the credit balance
app.update_title: You run v{{current}}. Open the release notes and downloads (Docker: pull the new image).

status.backend_offline_hint: Cannot reach the local server — check that the backend is running

roon.authorize_prompt: Open Roon → Settings → Extensions and enable
roon.lan_blocked_title: macOS is blocking local network access
roon.lan_blocked_body: The Roon Core was found at {{host}}, but macOS does not let TextFromTrack Companion connect to it. Enable the app in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network — it reconnects within 10 seconds.

now_playing.title: Title
now_playing.empty_idle_hint: Play something in Roon — its lyrics will show up here.
now_playing.empty_backend_offline_hint: The companion server is not answering. Check that the app (or its Docker container) is running.
now_playing.empty_lan_blocked_hint: Allow the app in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
now_playing.empty_roon_not_found_hint: Make sure Roon is running on this network. If the Core is on another subnet or in Docker, set ROON_CORE_HOST.
now_playing.empty_waiting_auth_hint: Open Roon → Settings → Extensions and enable “TextFromTrack Roon Companion”.
now_playing.frozen_banner: Working on {{file}} — the panels below no longer follow the track playing now.
now_playing.frozen_banner_nofile: The panels below no longer follow the track playing now.

match.confirm_medium: Confidence is not high — confirm before sending
match.hint_duration: Duration · within 2 s = 20, within 5 s = 10 · max 20
match.hint_filename: File name contains the title · max 10
match.hint_isrc: International Standard Recording Code · exact match · max 60
match.no_match_hint: No file in your music folder matches this track. Lyrics above still work; rescan your library if the file exists.

tft.no_token: No API key configured — add your TextFromTrack key in ⚙ Settings
tft.invalid_token: API key rejected (401) — regenerate your token on textfromtrack.com and update it in ⚙ Settings
tft.no_credits: No credits remaining — top up your account on textfromtrack.com
tft.lyrics_exist: Lyrics already exist — check "Re-transcribe" above to overwrite
tft.no_match: No local file matched for this track — the file is required to generate lyrics
tft.low_confidence_warning: The file match confidence is low — the matched file may be incorrect.
tft.low_confidence_confirm: I understand — proceed anyway with this file
tft.low_confidence_confirm_required: Please confirm the low-confidence match to proceed
tft.force_retranscribe: Re-transcribe even if lyrics already exist
tft.force_warning: Existing .lrc will be deleted; existing LYRICS tag will be renamed to LYRICS.ORG.
tft.embed_lyrics: Also embed [LYRICS] tag in audio file
tft.embed_unsupported: Embedding not supported for {{ext}} files (MP3 / FLAC only)
tft.backup_before_embed: Save a .org backup of the original file first
tft.save_lrc_beside_source: Save LRC file next to audio source
tft.lyrics_embedded_ok: Lyrics embedded into the audio file
tft.quality_degraded: Low quality — some segments may have been removed
tft.phase_retrying: Quality too low — retrying with vocal isolation…
tft.help_audio_type: Auto: let TFT decide. Speech: optimised for voice. Music: activates Demucs vocal isolation and a stricter hallucination filter.
tft.help_timestamps: Auto: TFT decides. Required: forces LRC-compatible timestamps. None: text-only output, faster.
tft.help_language: ISO 639-1 code (e.g. fr, en, ja). Leave blank for automatic detection.
tft.help_vintage: Forces large-v3 model and Demucs separation. Much slower (~6×) but may give better results for difficult tracks.

jobs.no_timestamps_tip: Timestamps unavailable — fallback model was used. Use the ↻ button to retry.
jobs.no_timestamps_tip_with_mode: Timestamps unavailable — TFT applied mode "{{mode}}" (requested "{{requested}}"). Use the ↻ button to retry.
jobs.no_timestamps_tip_v17_missing: Timestamps unavailable. Requested "{{requested}}" but the TFT response did not echo timestamps_mode — the deployed API likely pre-dates v1.7 and silently ignored the param. Retry will not help until TFT v1.7 is deployed.
jobs.retry_tip: Delete this LRC and re-submit for transcription
jobs.embedded_tip: Lyrics also embedded as [LYRICS] tag in the audio file
jobs.embed_tip: Embed [LYRICS] tag into the audio file now
jobs.backup_conflict_body: A backup already exists at the path below. What should we do?
jobs.lyrics_not_available: Lyrics not available for this job
jobs.source_cache_tip: Served from the local cache (0 credits)

search.title: Search Roon
search.play_now_tip: Play this on the selected Roon zone

tft_key.title: TextFromTrack API Key
tft_key.env_fallback: (from .env — enter a key below to override)
tft_key.check_invalid: ✗ TextFromTrack rejected this key — paste a new one.

settings.volume_step_hint: How many units the volume changes on each + / − click in the player.
settings.roon_poll_ms_hint: How often the now-playing info is refreshed (progress bar, volume…). Lower = more reactive, higher = less network traffic.
settings.embed_lyrics_default: Embed [LYRICS] tag in audio file by default
settings.embed_lyrics_default_hint: When enabled, the LRC content is also written into the file's LYRICS tag (MP3 ID3v2 USLT, FLAC Vorbis comment). The .lrc sidecar is still saved.
settings.backup_before_embed_default_hint: Creates Track.flac.org / Track.mp3.org next to the original before any tag write, so the file can be restored if anything goes wrong.
settings.save_lrc_beside_source_default: Save LRC file next to audio source
settings.save_lrc_beside_source_default_hint: When enabled, the .lrc sidecar file is saved next to the audio file. Roon does not read LRC files natively — leave this off if you only use embedded lyrics.
settings.server_log_hint: Last lines of the server log — useful for remote debugging
settings.log_empty: Log file is empty or not yet created.
settings.log_unavailable: Log unavailable (dev mode — Electron not running)
settings.sys_info_hint: Runtime memory and disk usage for the current session
settings.title: Settings
settings.save_failed: Not saved — the server rejected the change. Reload the page and try again.
settings.load_failed: Could not load the library settings.
settings.root_missing: Folder not found: {{path}} — is the drive or NAS mounted?
settings.auto_save_lrclib_hint: When the playing track matches a file that has no lyrics and LRCLIB has synced lyrics, write them into the file (with the options above). Each save appears in Job History.

lrclib.embed_lyrics: Also embed [LYRICS] tag in audio file
lrclib.backup_before_embed: Save a .org backup of the original file first
lrclib.save_lrc_beside_source: Save LRC file next to audio source
lrclib.no_match: No local file match — cannot save

lyrics.tft_no_preview: Lyrics generated — check your App Preferences to save or embed them.
lyrics.no_match: No local file matched — cannot transfer
lyrics.sync_disabled: No timestamps in this LRC — sync unavailable
lyrics.unsaved_title: Unsaved lyrics for the previous track
lyrics.unsaved_body: Lyrics found/generated for the previous track have not been transferred to File Tags yet. Save them before switching to the new track?

stage.title: Lyrics
stage.saved_sidecar: Saved as a .lrc file next to the track.
stage.lrclib_unreachable: LRCLIB is unreachable ({{msg}}). Retrying in a minute.
stage.not_found: No lyrics found for this track. Try “Other versions” with a simpler title.
stage.tip_click_line: Click a line to jump there.
stage.library_hint: Add your music folder to save lyrics into your files and generate AI lyrics with TextFromTrack.
stage.no_versions: LRCLIB has no version of this title.
stage.not_found_short: No lyrics found for this track.

library.title: Library lyrics
library.empty: The library index is empty — scan your music folder in Settings.
library.batch_start_one: Fetch lyrics from LRCLIB for this track
library.batch_start_other: Fetch lyrics from LRCLIB for these {{count}} tracks
library.batch_hint: Free. One track per second; lyrics already in or next to a file are never replaced. Written using your Files Management defaults.
library.batch_waiting: LRCLIB is busy ({{msg}}) — retrying in {{secs}} s.
library.batch_counts: Saved {{saved}} · not on LRCLIB {{not_found}} · without timestamps {{plain}} · already had lyrics {{had}} · failed {{failed}}

errors.TFT_TOKEN_MISSING: No TextFromTrack API key — add one in Settings.
errors.TFT_UNAUTHORIZED: TextFromTrack rejected the API key — check it in Settings.
errors.TFT_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Not enough TextFromTrack credits for this track.
errors.TFT_RATE_LIMITED: TextFromTrack is limiting requests — try again in a minute.
errors.TFT_TRACK_TOO_LONG: This track is too long for TextFromTrack.
errors.TFT_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: TextFromTrack only accepts MP3, FLAC and WAV files.
errors.TFT_EXPORT_EXPIRED: The transcription export has expired — generate it again.
errors.TFT_INTERNAL_ERROR: TextFromTrack had an internal error — try again later.
errors.NO_LOCAL_MATCH: No file in your music folder matches this track.
errors.LOW_CONFIDENCE_MATCH: The file match is uncertain — confirm it before generating.
errors.SOURCE_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The audio file was not found — was it moved, or is the drive unmounted?
errors.FORBIDDEN: This file is outside your music folders.
errors.OUTSIDE_MUSIC_ROOT: This file is outside your music folders.
errors.LYRICS_EMBED_UNSUPPORTED: Lyrics can only be embedded in MP3 and FLAC files.
errors.LYRICS_EMBED_FAILED: Could not write the lyrics into the file ({{msg}}).
errors.BACKUP_EXISTS: A backup (.org) of this file already exists.
errors.READ_ONLY: The music folder is read-only. In Docker, mount it with “:rw” to save lyrics.
errors.NO_PERMISSION: No permission to write this file ({{msg}}).
errors.BACKEND_UNREACHABLE: The companion server is not answering.
